items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Pat' multiple times (e.g., 'Pat, do you know that to me', 'Pat, you know?'), indicating the interviewer is Pat Suzuki. The relationship is professional/interviewer-interviewee.

ctx.x: Is it -- do you think it comes off of Basie, or is it -- what is the spark? Is Basie the spark in that band that gets it together?

Oh, I have to see. Well, I have to give it to Basie, because he had the first band. He's had five or six or seven different bands. But he gets about -- the common denominator is the same. As with Ellington. Still get that -- those two guys had a knack, you know. Basie still has it. They had a knack of getting some -- the musical thing out of the men, and to hold it together. Every time they -- oh, of course, Pat, as you know, there were different levels. Sometimes the guys would get tired, being on the road. But…
